title: Teaching Your Models to Understand Code via Focal Preference Alignment
authors_zh: Jie Wu、Haoling Li、Xin Zhang、Xiao Liu、Yangyu Huang、Jianwen Luo、Yizhen Zhang、Zuchao Li、Ruihang Chu、Yujiu Yang、Scarlett Li
paper_type_zh: 代码偏好数据集与细粒度 DPO 方法
best_for_zh: 需要依据测试反馈训练代码纠错模型、代码 DPO 或奖励模型的研究者
one_line: Target-DPO releases CodeFlow, 59,000 iterative-debugging code preference pairs that focus DPO on the tokens resolving test-verified errors.
CodeFlow 发布约 5.9 万代码偏好对，聚焦模型最易混淆的局部质量差异，适合代码推理 DPO 与奖励建模。
why: It turns an iterative code repair trajectory into a preference record that isolates the error-resolving part of the edit.
inclusion_reason: CodeFlow supplies code preference pairs whose preferred revision resolves a test-verified error, enabling focal preference alignment at the token level.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Conventional code DPO labels whole candidate programs as chosen or rejected according to test pass rates, even when a failing program differs only in a small error region. Applying preference gradients to the entire block treats many identical correct tokens as differences and weakens learning of error-location–repair relationships.

The paper proposes Target-DPO and constructs CodeFlow by iteratively generating, locating failure regions, and revising code until tests pass. Changes between adjacent versions form fine-grained preferences, and training emphasizes tokens associated with the actual repair.

常规代码 DPO 根据测试通过率把整段候选代码标为 chosen 或 rejected，但失败程序往往只在少数局部 token 上出错。对整段代码统一施加偏好梯度会把大量相同且正确的部分也当作差异，削弱模型学习“错误位置—修复操作”的能力。

论文提出 Target-DPO，并构造 CodeFlow：让模型像调试程序一样反复生成、定位失败区域和修改代码，直到通过测试；相邻版本的修改形成细粒度偏好，训练时只强化与修复相关的目标 token。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper proposes Target-DPO and constructs CodeFlow by iteratively generating, locating failure regions, and revising code until tests pass. Changes between adjacent versions form fine-grained preferences, and training emphasizes tokens associated with the actual repair. CodeFlow releases roughly 59K code-preference records centered on a failing version, its subsequent repair, test feedback, and modified error region for the same problem. Samples arise from iterative test-driven refinement rather than comparing pass rates of independent completions. Data and training code are released with Target-DPO for code DPO and repair learning.

论文提出 Target-DPO，并构造 CodeFlow：让模型像调试程序一样反复生成、定位失败区域和修改代码，直到通过测试；相邻版本的修改形成细粒度偏好，训练时只强化与修复相关的目标 token。CodeFlow 公开约 5.9 万条代码偏好记录，核心对象是同一题目的错误版本、后续修复版本、测试反馈及修改区域；样本通过迭代测试执行形成，而不是仅比较独立采样代码的总通过率。数据和训练代码随 Target-DPO 仓库发布，主要用于代码 DPO 与错误修复学习。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build the source pool: Start from executable coding problems and standard tests, generate an initial candidate with a base Code LLM, and run the tests.
  1. Generate or reorganize feedback: Use execution feedback to locate likely error spans in failing code and request a revision while preserving unaffected implementation.
  1. Verify and filter: Repeat revision and execution until tests pass or a stopping rule is reached, turning adjacent versions and modified tokens into CodeFlow preferences.
  1. Train and evaluate: Target-DPO augments the ordinary DPO objective with focal masks or weights so most gradient targets error and repair regions; model training is secondary to the data pipeline.

1. 建立数据源： 从可执行代码题和标准测试出发，由基础 Code LLM 生成初始候选并运行测试。
  1. 生成或重组反馈： 对失败代码依据执行反馈定位疑似错误片段，要求模型保持其余实现不变并产生下一轮修复。
  1. 验证与筛选： 重复“修改—执行”直到测试通过或达到停止条件，把连续版本及其修改 token 组织为 CodeFlow 偏好样本。
  1. 训练与评测： Target-DPO 在常规 DPO 目标上加入 focal mask/weight，使主要梯度落在错误与修复区域；模型训练部分相对数据构造简写。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Across several code models and HumanEval, MBPP, and BigCodeBench-style tasks, the paper reports consistent gains and fewer local defects. The key controlled comparison uses the same CodeFlow data and shows that focusing the objective on modified tokens outperforms whole-block DPO. Gains vary by base model and benchmark, so they should not be attributed solely to the 59K scale. These results support the central claim only under the released data, model scales, candidate budgets, and evaluation protocols; cross-domain use requires new validation.

论文在多种代码模型和 HumanEval、MBPP、BigCodeBench 等任务上报告稳定提升，且错误分析显示 Target-DPO 生成的程序包含更少局部缺陷；最关键的受控比较是同一 CodeFlow 数据上，聚焦修改 token 的目标优于整段 DPO。具体增益随 base model 与基准变化，因此不应把全部提升归因于 5.9 万样本的规模。 这些结果支持论文的核心主张，但只适用于其公开数据、模型规模、候选预算和评测协议；跨领域使用仍需重新验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing code-preference sets usually treat an entire program with more passing tests as positive. This work reduces the preference unit to the error region that actually changes along a debugging trajectory and forms pairs from causally connected before/after versions rather than unrelated samples.
现有代码偏好集通常把“通过更多测试的完整程序”作为正例；本文把偏好单位缩小到调试轨迹中真正变化的错误区域，并让数据对来自因果相连的前后版本，而非两个互不相关的采样答案。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Coverage boundary: Error localization depends on tests and diff heuristics; with weak coverage, a “repair” may overfit visible tests.
  1. Feedback risk: Adjacent versions are highly correlated, so random splitting can leak the same problem or near duplicates; deduplicate by task and source.
  1. Reproduction and use: Target-DPO depends on focal-mask quality; repository or multi-file repair requires a new definition of the changed region.

1. 覆盖边界： 错误定位依赖测试反馈和差分启发式；若测试覆盖不足，所谓修复可能只针对可见测试过拟合。
  1. 反馈风险： 连续版本高度相关，随机划分可能造成同题或近重复泄漏，评测前需按题目与来源去重。
  1. 复现与使用： Target-DPO 的优势与 focal mask 质量绑定；迁移到仓库级代码或多文件修复时需要重新定义修改区域。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluation: Train code DPO or reward models on CodeFlow so the model learns local repair rather than only whole-program ranking.
  1. Training: Reuse iterative debugging to generate custom chosen/rejected pairs while retaining test logs, diffs, and stopping reasons for audit.
  1. Transfer or deployment: Compare whole-code and focal DPO under controlled ablations; success should combine hidden-test pass rate with reductions in error categories.

1. 评测： 用 CodeFlow 训练代码 DPO/ORM，使模型学习局部错误修复而不是仅区分完整程序优劣。
  1. 训练： 复用迭代调试流程生成自己的 chosen/rejected 对，并保留测试日志、diff 与停止原因用于审计。
  1. 迁移或部署： 在消融中比较 whole-code DPO 与 focal DPO；成功应由隐藏测试通过率和错误类型减少共同判断。

  1. Data takeaway: CodeFlow releases roughly 59K code-preference records centered on a failing version, its subsequent repair, test feedback, and modified error region for the same problem.
